sections.heading: Planning your Verandah @ Kallang interior
sections.text:
Kallang and Whampoa form a central, mixed, older town on the edge of the city. Owners approaching keys here usually want a first fit-out that is compact and exacting: circulation kept clear, a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall rather than a cluster of loose cabinets. Maison designs that work as built-in carpentry, not as flat-pack furniture, and we can present it in a wide view or in closer material studies. No official floor plan is on file, so typologies and room sizes are not listed.

Towner Residences and Kent Heights are already live on this site in Kallang/Whampoa and are the natural nearby pages. Farrer Park Arena and Farrer Park Fields are other unconfirmed HDB pages in the same town and should not be used as a date guide. Dorset Gardens, packed earlier in District 8, is a nearby private-housing link only. We will not invent walking times to any MRT station, and we will not assign a river or city view to your block.

After keys, inspect defects and apply for the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial figure only. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and any key letter you have. We are not affiliated with HDB.
